description: Stop an AI process by its exact display name. Prefer stop_project: it takes the id from list_projects, works for projects and AI processes alike, and the id is what every other tool uses. Use this only when you know an AI process by name alone. Does not apply to permanent projects. If no AI process has exactly that name, nothing is stopped, but the response still reads as sent.

name.description: Exact display name of the AI process, as shown in list_projects.
